task.title: Configure Firefox AI and smart-feature policies
task.shortdesc: Use Step 5 for existing Firefox browser policy controls related to AI & smart features, visual search, and smart surfaces on supported Release schemas.

prereq.p: A Release schema that supports the controls is selected, or you understand that ESR 140.12 may omit them.

context.p: This topic documents existing Firefox policy settings as product functionality. It does not add AI functionality to the 0.9.1 documentation portal: RAG, embeddings, generative search, and generative answers remain out of scope.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Review the built-in browser AI surfaces, visual search, and smart browser features listed for the selected Release schema.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Enable, disable, or leave each supported policy according to the profile goal.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: If a control is absent on ESR 140.12, treat it as unsupported rather than manually inventing a Guided setting.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: Supported Firefox AI and smart-feature policies are reviewed as product settings while the documentation portal remains non-AI for 0.9.1.

postreq.p: Recovery: if a stakeholder expected an absent ESR control, switch to a supported Release schema for review or document the unsupported state.
